interface: Use read_sheet, wire_svg, guide_files then review_wiring on a branch fixture. Evaluate published decision or ValueError as appropriate. Controls use a truthful local fixture oracle, plus one deliberately mistaken all-pass review to measure automation coverage.
cases: valid branched RGB PNG, one background-pixel edit; complete passing observation
keep original source+PNG but swap sink pin identifiers between the two branch routes in passing verdict records
add a black conductor from the independent reference net to the signal branch in the PNG; report an observed failed connections/global check
use same extra-conductor PNG with a complete but mistaken all-pass verdict bound to its actual bytes
reject if automatic topology checking is claimed; otherwise measured manual-trust limitation
encode the benign positive pixels as actual BMP with .png filename
real PNG at one pixel below the required canvas width, preserve benign pixel data
normal_interface: Each case receives a fresh output directory; rejected verdict decisions may produce an audit record. A returned accepted is the sole passing positive. Record exception class and exact decoder/plugin calls attributable to candidate bytes.
measurement: Run identical fixture against the baseline and each isolated candidate, one cold subprocess per version. Local wall time descriptive only; no tuning followed by a claim of blind performance.
